scope: One seen training song. Ranking stored greedy and seed42 outputs only; no inference or time snapping. Does not rank generalization or musical quality.
selection: Only completed outputs; maximize full-song time+64-bin+type note F1, then consecutive-four-group reproduction, onset F1, smaller tail error, later epoch.

definitions.joint_f1: Existing 50ms one-to-one unique-onset matching, then same 64-bin position and type within each group. Denominator includes all notes. Excludes Hold duration.
definitions.continuous_x: Plot actual bin_to_hit(bin,residual)=0.05+0.9*(bin+residual)/64. Matched-coordinate MAE is separate, no extra coordinate threshold.
definitions.sequence: Four consecutive reference groups with identical bin+type multisets and consecutive prediction groups; denominator is all reference four-group windows.
definitions.differences: Red rings: prediction note lacking a time+bin+type match. Gray crosses: unmatched reference note. Not a verdict on alternate valid compositions; excludes Hold-length differences.
